verdict.rationale: Notion offers general AI building blocks that could be assembled into this workflow: always-on agents, cited Q&A, an Agent API for chat sessions, and MCP read/create/update of workspace content. Notion Skills can hold instructions for repeatable workflows, and webhooks report page and property changes. However, no evidence shows a native feature that drafts a project or initiative status update from recent activity, so the user would have to set this up themselves. Missing for 10: documented AI status-update or summary drafting for projects, summarization of recent activity or change history, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
